classdef.name: EndnoteOption
classdef.shortdesc: Options for specifying default endnote formatting.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the EndnoteOption (a Application or Document).

property.name: endnoteTitle
property.shortdesc: Title of the endnotes. (Limit: 0 to 100 characters)

property.name: endnoteTitleStyle
property.shortdesc: The paragraph style to apply to endnote title.

property.name: endnoteNumberingStyle
property.shortdesc: The endnote numbering style. Can return: FootnoteNumberingStyle enumerator or String.

property.name: startEndnoteNumberAt
property.shortdesc: The number at which to start endnote numbering.

property.name: restartEndnoteNumbering
property.shortdesc: The point at which to restart endnote numbering. Can return: EndnoteRestarting enumerator or String.

property.name: endnoteMarkerPositioning
property.shortdesc: The position of endnote reference numbers in the main text. Can return: FootnoteMarkerPositioning enumerator or String.

property.name: endnoteMarkerStyle
property.shortdesc: The character style to apply to endnote reference numbers in the main text.

property.name: endnoteTextStyle
property.shortdesc: The paragraph style to apply to endnote text.

property.name: endnoteSeparatorText
property.shortdesc: The text to insert between the endnote marker number and the endnote text. (Range: 0 to 100 characters)

property.name: scopeValue
property.shortdesc: Scope value of the endnotes. Can return: EndnoteScope enumerator or String.

property.name: frameCreateOption
property.shortdesc: Frame creation of the endnotes. Can return: EndnoteFrameCreate enumerator or String.

property.name: showEndnotePrefixSuffix
property.shortdesc: The position of the endnote prefix and/or suffix. Can return: FootnotePrefixSuffix enumerator or String.

property.name: endnotePrefix
property.shortdesc: The prefix text of the endnote. (Limit: 0 to 100 characters)

property.name: endnoteSuffix
property.shortdesc: The suffix text of the endnote. (Limit: 0 to 100 characters)

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the EndnoteOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
